sources.finding: clock_set_calendar_microtime adjusts clock_boottime and clock_boottime_usec by the forward or backward calendar delta. clock_get_boottime_microtime returns these stored values.
boottime_timeval obtains seconds and microseconds from clock_get_boottime_microtime.
kern.boottime uses boottime_timeval. kern.bootsessionuuid separately exports bootsessionuuid_string with read-only and locked sysctl flags.

primaryResearch.inference: Exact boottime seconds/microseconds equality is unsuitable as an immutable boot-session predicate. This source supports the narrower session-UUID check; it does not establish the cause of this Mac's observed timestamp change.
